content: {"episode_id":"ep-05165","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229 for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring on episode ep-05165. The clinical indication note documents that \"the patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia and underlying atrial fibrillation,\" supporting diagnosis codes I48.91 and I47.1. The note further states that \"given the intermittent nature of these symptoms and the need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is ordered to capture arrhythmic events and guide further management.\" We submit this documentation of medical necessity in support of the outstanding balance of 719.93."}
